title: 5G Charging; Stage 3 (CHF SBI)
tagline: CHF — charging that reuses session policy types from 29.512
summary: TS 32.291 defines charging services on the CHF, including converged online/offline charging. It reuses QoS, charging, and session policy-related data types defined in TS 29.512. In the PDU session journey, charging rules in SmPolicyDecision connect session policy on PCF to what CHF meters on the user plane.
defines: Charging data types shared with 29.512 SmPolicyDecision
CHF as charging consumer of session and QoS information
Integration with SMF session charging triggers
whyItMatters: Session policy is not only QoS — SmPolicyDecision can carry charging rules. 32.291 explains how those rules become charging behaviour on CHF, linking the 29.512 policy vocabulary to billing.
